identity.name: Seamfinder Lens
identity.summary: A dark circular lens held between two copper arrowheads.
identity.description: While orthogonally touching the permanent Bowmaster quiver, adds 4 pierce, 2 damage to Volley; this equipment remains in the backpack and is not consumed.
identity.lore: The glass reveals the pale gaps between every armor plate.
